# Folzi AI

> Folzi AI is an AI-powered visual and text assistant for second-hand sellers, resellers, and thrift stores to automate marketplace listings on Vinted, Leboncoin, and eBay from a single photo.

Folzi AI analyzes clothing items, sneakers, and vintage pieces using computer vision, generates marketplace-optimized SEO titles and descriptions, embeds viral aesthetic hashtags (#Y2K, #QuietLuxury, #Gorpcore), and estimates real-time resale prices based on 2,400+ market sales.

## Features

- [Visual AI Scanner](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/): Instant clothing recognition, fabric analysis, and brand identification in 1.8 seconds.
- [Vinted AI Generator](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/vinted): Viral SEO titles, 100+ word descriptions, and trending aesthetic hashtags.
- [Leboncoin AI Generator](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/leboncoin): Polite, structured descriptions with dimensions, delivery choices, and pickup instructions.
- [Argus Price Estimator](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/estimation-prix): Real-time marketplace valuation based on 2,400+ completed sales.

## Guides

- [Guide - Sell on Vinted in 24h](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/guides/comment-vendre-sur-vinted): 7 rules for the 2026 Vinted algorithm including drip publishing and golden hours.
- [Guide - Leboncoin Listing Templates](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/guides/modele-annonce-leboncoin): Tested templates for furniture, tech, and clothing with negotiation buffer strategy.
- [Guide - Sneaker Argus & Valuation](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/guides/cote-argus-sneakers-vintage): Inspection checklist and condition grading table from Deadstock to Used.
- [Guide - Vintage Authentication](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/guides/comment-detecter-faux-vintage): How to authenticate vintage garments using single stitch hems, Talon zippers, and RN numbers.
